headline: Tennessee Death-Row Inmate Unconscious After Failed Injection
deck: Lawyers told a court that Tennessee death-row inmate Christa Pike was unconscious, intubated and on a ventilator Thursday night after a failed lethal injection.
body: Tennessee death-row inmate Christa Pike was unconscious, intubated and on a ventilator Thursday night after authorities failed to execute her by lethal injection, her lawyers said in court filings. [E1][E2]
Her lawyers filed an emergency motion on Friday to preserve "any and all evidence" related to her botched execution. [E3]
